hero.title: Dentistry in Spain for Indian Students
hero.subtitle: Studying Dentistry in Spain for Indian students is an opportunity to get a European dental qualification, develop clinical skills, and gain international academic exposure. Spanish universities provide undergraduate degrees in dentistry, called Grado en Odontología. These programs generally take five years to complete and are worth 300 ECTS credits.

overview: European education: Study in Spain's higher education system and gain international academic exposure.
Clinical learning: Dentistry degrees will include practical training and clinical components.
Five-year degree pathway: Most undergraduate Dentistry courses in Spain are structured in five years and 300 ECTS.

sections.title: Why Choose Dentistry in Spain?
sections.lead: European education: Study in Spain's higher education system and gain international academic exposure.

items: Clinical learning: Dentistry degrees will include practical training and clinical components.
Five-year degree pathway: Most undergraduate Dentistry courses in Spain are structured in five years and 300 ECTS.
English language options Some universities offer English language pathways. Availability and conditions vary.
Specialization opportunities: Graduates can undertake postgraduate study in orthodontics, periodontology, oral surgery and implant dentistry.
International experience: Live and study in Spain, and develop cross-cultural communication skills.
Career flexibility. Graduates may seek further education and licensing opportunities in Spain, India or elsewhere, depending on applicable regulations.

sections.title: Who is eligible to study dentistry in Spain
sections.lead: Indian students will normally have to meet the university's academic entry requirements and the relevant international-student entry rules.

items: Typical Dentistry eligibility in Spain for Indian students requirements may include:
Class 12 qualification: Secondary education equivalent to the Spanish qualification for university entry.
Science subjects Biology and Chemistry are especially important. Some universities may ask for other subjects.
Academic performance: The academic or entrance exam scores required may differ for each institution and admission process.
University admission assessment Applicants may be required to meet Spanish university entrance requirements, credential recognition or university-specific selection requirements.
Language proficiency: May require use of Spanish or other language used in teaching and clinical practice.
Passport and documents: A valid passport and correctly prepared academic documents are needed.
There are some public universities that are hard to get in to. Don't assume that just because you have passed class 12 you will get admission.

sections.title: Requirements for admission to Dentistry in Spain
sections.lead: The process of applying may differ for public and private universities. Dentistry admission requirements in Spain might include:

items: Certificate & Mark sheets of Class 10 and 12.
Copy of passport.
Academic credential recognition or equivalency documents as applicable.
Results of Spanish university entrance examinations or other accepted admission credentials as appropriate.
Proof of English or Spanish Language Proficiency.
University application form.
CV or personal statement if required.
Certified translations and where required document legalization or apostille.
Proof of financial resources for the visa.
Any other documents requested by the university or the Spanish Consulate.
Indian applicants should have the university confirm which credential-evaluation and entrance route applies to their particular school-qualification.

sections.title: How much does it cost to study dentistry in Spain?
sections.lead: The cost of studying Dentistry in Spain can vary a lot between public and private schools. Fees at public universities may also vary for non-EU students, and private universities generally charge higher fees.

items: Type of universityFor instance, annual tuitionApprox. INR
Public university5,000₹1.09 to ₹5.43 lakhs
Private University€12,000-€25,000+₹13.03-₹27.15 lakh+

These are estimates for planning purposes and not firm fees. For the 2026 intake, the Catholic University of Valencia lists its Dentistry degree at €12,780, and UIC Barcelona lists first-year tuition at €18,600, by reference.
INR conversions are at illustrative rate of €1 ≈ ₹108.60. University fees & real exchange rates may differ.

Students should also budget separately for accommodation, food, transport, health insurance, visa formalities, dental instruments and other course related expenses. Ask the university for a full breakdown of fees before you accept an offer.
Scholarships and financial aid might be available, but eligibility and funding vary widely from one institution to another and from one individual to another.

sections.title: Recognition of Dentistry Degree and Certificates
sections.lead: The undergraduate qualification in Spain is typically referred to as Grado en Odontología. Formal Dentistry programs in Spain are usually five years long, worth 300 ECTS credits, and involve clinical training.

items: University of Barcelona +Indian students check the following before enrollment:
The university and the specific program are officially recognized in Spain.
The degree complies with the professional requirements in force in Spain.
The program is documented in terms of training, duration and clinical aspects.
The qualification meets the current requirements for professional registration in the country where the student intends to practice.

Return to India is important: A degree in Dentistry from Spain does not automatically qualify a graduate to practice dentistry in India. Foreign dental graduates must refer to current National Dental Commission / Dental Council requirements including applicable screening examinations and conditions of registration prior to admission.

faqs.q: How many years are required to study Dentistry in Spain?
faqs.a: The normal undergraduate Dentistry degree in Spain lasts for five years and consists of 300 ECTS credits.

faqs.q: Can Indian students pursue Dentistry in Spain in English?
faqs.a: Yes, some universities have English language pathways or international cohorts. But many programs are conducted mostly in Spanish or a regional language. Students should also confirm the language requirements for clinical training.

faqs.q: How much does Dentistry in Spain cost for Indian students?
faqs.a: Public universities charge tuition of €1,000–€5,000 per year, while private programs can cost €12,000–€25,000 or more. These are indicative estimates, please check the current fee schedule of the chosen university.

faqs.q: After finishing Dentistry in Spain, can I practice in India?
faqs.a: Not by default . Before choosing a program, check the current requirements for recognition of foreign dental qualifications, screening examinations and registration in India.

faqs.q: Do Indian students need NEET to study Dentistry in Spain?
faqs.a: For Indian students who want to study dentistry abroad and then practice in India, the NEET and other eligibility requirements are important to consider. Please check the latest applicable Indian regulations with the relevant regulator before admission. Please check the entry requirements of the Spanish University separately.
